evidence.title: Equinix Launches Purpose-Built IBX Data Center in Mumbai to Accelerate India’s AI and Cloud Growth
evidence.excerpt: Equinix's dated release announces the opening of the MB3 IBX data center in Mumbai and reports initial facility capacity separately from full build-out.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 127406-byte content-decoded official HTML response body
metadata.capture_headers_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 711-byte raw HTTP response-header capture
metadata.capture_artifact_guardrail: The official HTML response body and raw response headers are not redistributed. This record retains exact byte counts, SHA-256 values, selected non-sensitive response facts, and compact factual extraction only.
metadata.request_credentials_guardrail: The request supplied no Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie header, cookie input, or cookie jar.
metadata.retrieval_method: Exact official content-decoded HTML response body and separate raw response headers captured with curl --fail --location --compressed --silent --show-error; request start and finish were recorded immediately around the request at one-second UTC precision.
metadata.retrieved_at_semantics: The evidence retrieved_at is the recorded request-start second and equals the response HTTP Date; the separate request-finish second is retained.
metadata.status_scope: The release explicitly announces the opening of MB3. This supports one campus operational observation as of the release date, with no finer commissioning, energization, occupancy, utilization, or load claim.
metadata.phase_identity_guardrail: The opening release describes MB3's initial facility capacity and does not reproduce the historical 'MB3 phase 2' row name or map the opening to phase 2. It creates no current lifecycle observation or current snapshot for the phase-2 project; no phase-2 completion is inferred.
metadata.historical_lifecycle_guardrail: The operational campus observation can coexist with the source-scoped phase-2 under_construction observation as of 2025-12-31. A functioning initial facility and a later phase under construction are compatible states at different entity scopes.
metadata.cabinet_guardrail: Cabinets are reported units of sellable space, not MW, critical IT load, gross facility demand, grid capacity, generation capacity, current load, annual energy, or measured consumption. No normalized capacity row is created.
metadata.investment_and_area_guardrail: Investment, land area, and storey count remain descriptive metadata. They do not establish power, energy, capacity, occupancy, utilization, physical phase allocation, or current consumption.
metadata.solar_scope_guardrail: The release attributes 26.4 MWp and expected annual generation of approximately 41.4 million kWh to a group captive solar project in India under a long-term agreement with CleanMax. It does not say the generation asset is on the MB3 site, dedicated exclusively to MB3, or equal to MB3 demand or consumption.
metadata.energy_guardrail: The solar MWp is generation nameplate and the kWh figure is expected off-site project generation, not MB3 critical IT load, gross facility demand, grid capacity, current load, annual facility consumption, measured consumption, or a data-center capacity row. Both remain evidence metadata only.
metadata.renewable_guardrail: The release says MB3 achieves 100% renewables coverage, but does not report facility consumption, PUE, hourly matching, delivered generation, or measured annual facility energy.
metadata.classification_guardrail: IBX, retail-data-center, purpose-built, high-performance, liquid-cooling, AI, machine-learning, hybrid-cloud, and interconnection language remains source context. It does not create a normalized operating model, workload, tenant, customer, user, installed hardware model, or role.
metadata.role_guardrail: Equinix, quoted customers and officials, CleanMax, cloud providers, networks, partners, and enterprises are not normalized into owner, operator, developer, tenant, customer, user, contractor, investor, utility, or other roles.
metadata.locality_guardrail: The release explicitly places MB3 in Chandivali, Powai, Central Mumbai and says it is adjacent to MB2. That locality is retained without geocoding; no street address, parcel, point, footprint, geometry, co-location merge, campus-boundary merge, or unique-site conclusion is inferred.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction under the publisher's all-rights-reserved terms; the captured source body and headers are not redistributed.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: No satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, analyst geolocation, or image-based inference contributes to identity, locality, lifecycle, capacity, energy, or classification.
